query_analysis.original_query: In our solvent recovery system, azeotrope formation is limiting separation efficiency. Would azeotropic distillation or extractive distillation be a better solution?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Evaluate and recommend the most suitable advanced distillation technique, either azeotropic distillation or extractive distillation, to overcome azeotrope limitations and improve separation efficiency in a solvent recovery system.

clarification_questions: What are the specific components in the solvent mixture?
What is the current separation efficiency and target efficiency?
Are there any constraints on the implementation of the distillation system?
